utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the sixteenth of June. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Hard to hear anything over the heating in the portakabin, mind. It's June and I'm being slow-roasted.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Luxury. Usually it's like sitting in a fridge.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: There is apparently no setting between fridge and blast furnace.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Speaking of ovens, the charity bake sale on Friday. Judging by last time, I'm buying something rather than baking.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Probably kinder to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Cheers. Lovely supportive team, this.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a disciplinary. Finished stuff first, then what's actually ours.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I tested the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And that's the completed one, not another test going on today's list?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. Closed out yesterday. Just feeding back.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me: signed off the inspection on the Site Water System on Tuesday. Already signed off, nothing new there.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good, both of those stay in the done pile.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, observations only from me. Heard a slight rattle from the turbine one, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, an observation, not you asking for someone to strip it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Definitely not. Also saw the pressure on the Gas Turbine 2 dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—came back without anyone doing anything?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Just reporting what I saw, no new job off that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And the shutdown on the booster pump is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, cancelled rather than pushed back a bit?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Cancelled. We're not carrying that shutdown as work to do today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On blockers, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Line 3 Chiller. That's still stuck, not something I can put into the running plan.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked status, not another action out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the turbine one either. Same story.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lots of certainty from suppliers, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Consistently uncertain. Anyway, still blocked; no new work to report on that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay. Actual jobs now. There's one that needs to cut straight through the usual queue.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Han, can you go to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the BFP? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll go to the substation and pick up the replacement parts for the BFP. Understood on dropping everything.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks. That's the priority for you, not something to fit round the edges.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, clear.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll do the pre-use checks on the trucks this morning. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Got it, Priya Raman on the pre-use checks on the trucks. Not waiting till later in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: We also need someone to check the guarding on the palletiser. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. Who can actually take the guarding check? I don't want a general nod being mistaken for an owner.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't take that one. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nor me, with the BFP parts taking priority. Don't put me against it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, nobody's taken the palletiser guarding check. It stays explicitly unowned.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah. Unowned doesn't make it less urgent, though. Still safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Agreed. Separately, I'll schedule downtime for the dryer with production tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30 for that, yeah? Just making sure I heard the half past.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, tomorrow at 9:30. I'll handle scheduling it with production.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll run a function test on the PRV on the boiler this afternoon. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, David Whitfield for the PRV on the boiler, this afternoon, no rush. Separate from the urgent bits.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's it. I'll take that test.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fi, can you do a site visit at Northfield with the contractor by the end of the week? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the site visit at Northfield with the contractor. By the end of the week is fine.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Lovely. No rush, as I say, just within that end-of-week limit.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, understood. It doesn't need squeezing in ahead of the urgent stuff.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Han, could you organise the toolbox talk for the team by Thursday, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that as well. Especially with dropping everything for the parts. That needs to go to someone else.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fair enough. Fiona, can I hand that to you instead—organise the toolbox talk for the team by Thursday, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead. I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Thanks. Better than me saying yes and it disappearing under everything else.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we're saying organised by Thursday, not saying the talk itself has to happen on Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Correct, organised by Thursday. That's all we're agreeing there.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Look at that, a meeting where saying no actually worked.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Don't sound so surprised. You nearly came off mute twice for that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Quick read-back, then. Han's got the replacement parts for the BFP from the substation, dropping everything for it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, mine.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And mine's the function test on the PRV on the boiler this afternoon. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I've got Northfield with the contractor by the end of the week, no rush, and organising the toolbox talk by Thursday, if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I've got the pre-use checks on the trucks this morning, safety critical, straight away; and scheduling downtime for the dryer with production tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And just so it doesn't vanish in the summary, the palletiser guarding still needs checking. Nobody has accepted that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Correct. No owner agreed for that one, and the safety-critical, straight-away urgency stands. I'm not marking it as covered.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, all clear from me. Assuming I haven't melted into this chair.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: All right, thanks everyone. That's us.
